sections.title: Building Investor Confidence through Clarity
sections.body: Investing in an infrastructure-heavy project in an emerging market requires a high degree of technical and legal due diligence. This FAQ is specifically designed for our equity partners to address the 'hard' questions of finance and governance. We cover everything from the mechanics of our quarterly dividend waterfall to the specifics of our 10-year tax holiday under the Kenyan SEZ Act. We understand that our investors are looking for 'Real Yield'—the combination of dollar-denominated cash flow and the appreciation of a hard physical asset. If you are representing a fund and require deeper analysis on our CAPEX contingency or our terminal value assumptions, our CFO is available for a 1-on-1 briefing. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track

sections.title: Top Investor Questions
items: Dividend Frequency: When do I see my first return? (Projected Q8 of operation).
Currency Risk: How do I get paid? (Strictly in USD via our international SPV).
Exit Liquidity: Who buys this in 5 years? (Global Hyperscalers or Infrastructure REITs).
Asset Security: Who owns the hardware? (The Joint Venture, with clear title for investors).
Regulatory Shield: What if the local tax laws change? (Locked-in SEZ protections).
